sources.scope: Published Valledupar DIVIPOLA 20001 urban U_TERRENO only. Rural cadastre is separate. Bounded checks do not prove urban or municipal completeness; 92270 snapshot rows versus 92280 reported viewer rows remain follow-up. Seven null-geometry rows are unavailable polygons, not fabricated or removed records. Duplicate codes and duplicate geometries with different composite IDs are preserved.

identity.recipe: Exact case-sensitive codigo + literal | + integer Shape_Id is the publisher identity. Canonical transport encodes each component with encodeSnapshotNativeId and joins with ~ after CO-VALLEDUPAR-. No row number, FID, geometry hash or deduplication is used. An empty codigo is preserved as an empty first tuple component; the native integer Shape_Id remains mandatory. Such rows are never merged or assigned file-order IDs.
identity.stabilityLimits: Composite unique in retained snapshot; continuity across a future publisher release remains unverified.

projection.operation: Inverse Transverse Mercator from publisher MAGNA-SIRGAS 2018 / Origen-Nacional PRJ to longitude,latitude; no fitted offsets, coordinate rounding, geometry repair or simplification.
